floorPlans.note: These six collection packs belong to the Takaya project. Each option preserves its complete original sheet and physical PDF page. Townhouse and Kaia figures describe the whole home across both drawing sheets, with the area-source page identified. Utility areas marked with an asterisk are excluded from published totals. Harmony and Symphony have separate collection packs with differing totals for some similarly named layout types. review.imagery: Root visually inspected every brochure-native candidate and retained eight own-project renders. Three brown textures and a legacy Union Properties landscape photograph were excluded. All nine dated official October 2026 site photographs were visually inspected. Original notices and watermarks remain. No completion percentage or as-built finish is inferred.
review.floorPlans: Root visually inspected all 213 selected complete original drawings across six plan packs, including every numeric table. Tower 46, Kalina 46, Kaia 10, Symphony 53, Harmony 26 and Melody 32 sheets. All twenty Harmony home and penthouse totals were independently transcribed from visible source tables after broken font encoding truncated leading digits. Penthouse identifiers 6.1 and 3A were read from the full headers. Unit-list and ancillary pages remain in each whole original PDF. Source area and revision conflicts are explicit.
review.location: Root visually inspected full original physical brochure page 8. Twelve destination-table estimates, the separate Al Maktoum airport map estimate and both intercity estimates were read. Dubai Marina table/map conflict remains explicit. Radius marks were excluded from journey distances. No exact visitor entrance pin was inferred from the project-name iframe.
review.provenance: All seven complete official PDFs, current project HTML and published photo originals were downloaded through ordinary public GET on 7 November 2026 with URL, date, byte length and SHA receipts. No form submissions or access-challenge bypass. All original notices, protected identities and researched project text are preserved.

unavailable: Exact building and visitor entrance coordinates, live journey times and a resolved Dubai Marina travel estimate remain unverified. Kaia V-03 component totals and collection drawing revisions require confirmation.
